title: PAN-OS / Panorama Compliance Evidence
description: Schema for the single Drata Custom Connection resource this connector publishes to (PAN_DRATA_RESOURCE_ID). One resource holds seven evidence shapes, distinguished by evidenceType; every record includes the CORE and DEVICE-TRACEABILITY fields, plus only the fields applicable to its own evidenceType. Generated from pan_drata_schemas.py -- keep in sync with that module's _build() calls if fields ever change.

id.description: Deterministic composite key, e.g. '<deviceId>:license:<feature>' -- re-runs upsert instead of duplicating.

service.description: Which surface answered the call: a firewall (pan_firewall) or Panorama itself, for its own device-group definitions (panorama).

name.description: Human-readable label shown in the Drata UI. Recommended displayNameKey for this Custom Connection resource.

timestamp.description: Run timestamp, ISO 8601. Shared by every record produced in one run.

managedBy.description: Whether the firewall this record came from is itself Panorama-managed.

securityProfileGroup.description: SECURITY_RULE only -- named Security Profile Group attached to the rule, if any.

securityProfiles.description: SECURITY_RULE only -- individually-attached profiles keyed by category (virus, spyware, vulnerability, url-filtering, file-blocking, wildfire-analysis, data-filtering, gtp, sctp), each an array of profile names.

affectedCount.description: TRAFFIC_LOG_SUMMARY / URL_FILTERING_LOG_SUMMARY / DNS_THREAT_LOG_SUMMARY only -- subset of totalLogCount matching the evidence-relevant condition (denied traffic, blocked/alerted URL, or -- for DNS threat -- every entry, since the query is already filtered).

actionBreakdown.description: TRAFFIC_LOG_SUMMARY only -- count per raw log `action` value.

categoryBreakdown.description: URL_FILTERING_LOG_SUMMARY / DNS_THREAT_LOG_SUMMARY only -- count per raw log `category` value.
